items.desc_now: Remote-work assistant for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): SSH into any machine, pick a remote workspace, and work on it with 22 rw_* tools, conflict-aware SFTP mirror, embedded PTY terminal, port forwarding, and multi-hop jumps - under the same sandbox policy as a local session.
items.desc_prev: Remote-work assistant for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): connect SSH (key or password), pick a remote workspace, operate with rw_* tools, and SFTP-mirror it into a real local DSH workspace.

items.desc_now: DSH 扩展坞｜给 DeepSeek Harness 插上更多接口：快速追加、PTC 派活、中断报警与自用桌宠。全自动派发规格包实测 token 缓存命中 99.6%、约 ¥5.47/亿 token（需严格自动派发 + Ponytail + DeepSeek V4.1-Flash）。
items.desc_prev: DSH 扩展坞｜给 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插上更多接口：输入框预存文案/预存命令一键追加、一句话把整件事派给 PTC 子代理、长任务中断分级报警。DSH plugins for DeepSeek Harness: quick-append / ptc-task / dialogue-alert

items.desc_now: 你的助手记得昨天——直到上下文撑不住。DSH 自带压实写摘要（有损），这个插件保留全文：折叠的消息原样归档到本地，替换它的是真实前缀构成的提取式索引，不加一句模型生成的话。笔记还能从会话日志重建。Persistent memory for DeepSeek Harness: fold old history into one extractive index backed by a verbatim local archive. Nothing summarised, nothing invented, and the notes can be rebuilt from the session logs.
items.desc_prev: DSH 会话越长越慢、每轮越贵？把最老的历史折叠成一条带索引的消息，全文归档到本地、随时能沿路径找回来，不调用模型写摘要。DeepSeek Harness plugin: folds the oldest history span into one indexed message backed by a lossless local archive.
